label: Contamination
why_not_a_term_request: Not a place. BacDive records that a strain was isolated as a contaminant — of a product, a culture or a cleanroom — which is a circumstance of sampling rather than an environment ENVO models. ENVO:00002204 is kept as an xref (#99).

label: Invertebrates-Other
why_not_a_term_request: A residual bucket. 'Other' has no meaning of its own — it is defined by what the sibling categories already took — so there is no concept for an ontology to define.

label: Rodentia-Other
why_not_a_term_request: A residual BacDive #Host bucket for rodent hosts not assigned to the sibling #Muridae (Mouse/Rat). The host environment is real and parented to animal-associated environment, but a negative “everything else” partition is not a stable ontology class: its extension changes whenever the source vocabulary adds another sibling (#192).

label: Rock core/Sediment
why_not_a_term_request: Two materials conflated in one GOLD node. Requesting a term for 'rock core or sediment' would ask ENVO to mint the conflation; the fix belongs upstream in GOLD. Parented to sediment.

label: Biopsy
why_not_a_term_request: Its committed research report concludes no, explicitly: a sampling artefact individuated by how the specimen was obtained rather than by any property of the place. The 95 strains came from many different anatomical sites, so a single term would merge unrelated habitats. NCIT:C15189 stays an xref and the CLINICAL category stays pinned; parent_habitats is left empty because 'we do not know where this is' is the honest state of the data (#110).

label: Core-sample
why_not_a_term_request: Its committed research report concludes no: a specimen form named by the tool that extracted it, which MIxS records in samp_type rather than in the environmental triad. Every strain checked also carries its own place tags upstream (Marine, Terrestrial, Geologic), so nothing is orphaned by declining. Minting a term would merge glacier ice, marine sediment, saprolite and deep shale into one cross-cutting class - the failure the ambiguous-leaf rule exists to prevent. Whether the record should also move from CONFIRM_UNGROUNDED to NOT_APPLICABLE is left open (#110).
